body.x: Lillycover will participate in the world’slargest technology exhibition CES 2020 opening in Las Vegas on Jan. 7-10 toshowcase its AI skin diagnosis device Muilli and personalized cosmetics Eldo,Jubar – Time miracle/Black miracle, and in-city customized flexible production2 Point Cosmetics.

Lilycover's Muilli is designed to be easyto carry for busy modern people who don't have time and money to carry skincare smartly at home and at work. With the accuracy and multi-function as wellas high value with outstanding skin diagnosis that is different from variousdiagnostic devices and beauty devices out in the market, it is providing totalbeauty solution which enables smart skin management.

With 60 X magnification camera and sensor installed in the device, it accurately diagnoses skin redness, pores, wrinkles, oil and moisture balance, and provides real-time results and information on skin type and condition by connecting to mobile application.

In addition, our customized cosmetics line, Eldo Balance Mask Pack and Jubar – Black Miracle/Time Miracle, are recommended according to the results of skin diagnosis. It has been attracting the attention of domestic and foreign customers through purchase or subscription service.

In particular, Eldo Balance Mask Pack ismade of natural coconut cellulose, so it is adhesive and functional, and iseffective for wrinkles, whitening, and calming. Miracle line shows excellenteffect on removing deep wrinkles and acne.

Lilycover developed diagnostic algorithms with dermatologists and university hospitals based on more than 110,000 pieces of skin data. In 2020, it is planning to launch 2 Point Cosmetic smart factory that makes skincare products starting from skin diagnosis - production - sales in the vending machine. Lilycover's Muilli and customized cosmetics are currently expanding to China, Japan and Vietnam, and are planning to grow into a global beauty tech company by expanding the market to the United States, East Asia and Europe.
